messages:
rachel_finance: Heads up: our pricing experiment for per-second billing rolled yesterday but the MTD revenue shows a ~35% drop for the experiment cohort. Looks like many experiment invoices have zero usage lines in NetSuite despite Stripe showing consumption. https://redwood.internal/billing/experiments/1769
marco_eng: Checking the sync service (stripe-to-ns). I see a consumer mismatch: the experiment emitter writes usage events with metric_name 'compute_seconds_v2' but the ns-mapper only maps 'compute_seconds'. That causes the mapper to drop lines and NetSuite gets an invoice with no usage rows.
nina_billing: Which customers are affected? We need to know the revenue impact and whether any collections were attempted.
marco_eng: Quick query to find candidates: SELECT s.customer_id, s.invoice_id FROM stripe_events s LEFT JOIN net_suite_invoices n ON s.event_id = n.source_event_id WHERE s.type = 'invoice.created' AND s.payload->>'metric_name' = 'compute_seconds_v2' AND n.id IS NULL;
chrissy_support: I've flagged 47 customers in the experiment segment and opened a support queue. I'll draft a proactive note offering credits if needed.
deploy-bot: rollout: stripe-to-ns v3.2.0 started by ci-bot at 2026-04-11T13:05Z :rocket:
marco_eng: Root cause: feature flag refactor changed the metric mapping table and a default mapping dropped the suffix. Patch: add explicit mapping entry for 'compute_seconds_v2' -> 'compute_seconds_v2_ns' and include a fallback that emits a warn instead of dropping. I'll open PR now. ETA hotfix 1.5h.
rachel_finance: Please run a backfill plan once hotfix is live. We need to generate missing net_suite_invoice_lines and create adjustment memos where appropriate. Also include audit fields so we can tie adjustments to original stripe_event ids.
marco_eng: Plan: 1) deploy mapping fix 2) run a dry-run backfill that lists affected invoices and the lines we'd create 3) after finance sign-off, run backfill and queue NetSuite adjustments with tag 'experiment-backfill-2026-04-11' 4) add a monitoring alert for dropped metric_name counts.
nina_billing: Add me to the dry-run output. Also include a CSV we can upload to the accounting system for review.
chrissy_support: I'll hold customer comms until after dry-run. For the 47 flagged customers, I'll send an "investigating" update now.
marco_eng: logs snippet showing drop: 2026-04-11T13:03:41Z WARN mapper: unknown metric_name compute_seconds_v2, dropping usage line for invoice in_7AqX...
rachel_finance: Thanks. Pause any auto-credit automation until we confirm adjustments. Keep this thread updated."
